data.name: Averie
data.gender_notes: Averie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old French name 'Averia', meaning 'elf ruler'. In Greek mythology, Averia was an alternative name for the goddess Aphrodite, representing the power of love and beauty. The name Averie carries the meaning “Elf ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Averie usually hope their child will grow to embody elf ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of love and beauty, representing the divine feminine.
data.etymology: Averie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elf ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Averie total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אברי
in_hebrew.meaning: אברי - שמות פרטיים נוצריים עם משמעות עמוקה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אברי הוא שם פרטי נוצרי שמקורו בשפה האנגלית ומשמעותו 'חיות שפיר' או 'עופות'. השם אברי קשור לשם העברי 'עבר', שפירושו 'עבר' או 'חצי'. במסורת הנוצרית, השם אברי משויך לאיכויות של חיות ושפיר, ומשקף את האמונה באלוהים כבורא ומחיה של כל היצורים.

in_greek.name: Αβερ
in_greek.meaning: Αβερ - ο χριστιανικός όνομα με βαθιά σημασία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αβερ είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την αγγλική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'θηρία' ή 'πτηνά'. Το όνομα Αβερ συνδέεται με το εβραϊκό όνομα 'עבר', που σημαίνει 'πέρασμα' ή 'ημι'. Στην χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Αβερ συνδέεται με τις ιδιότητες των θηρίων και των πτηνών, και αντανακλά την πίστη στον Θεό ως δημιουργό και ζωοδότη όλων των πλασμάτων.

The name reflects spiritual themes of vitality, freedom, and the beauty of God's creation.

The legend mentions that she had a son named Milion, who was a great healer. Averie was said to have protected and guided her son, and her story is part of the rich folklore of Brittany.

Another reference to the name Averie comes from the 15th century English poem 'Sir Orfeo', in which Averie is described as the queen of the fairies. In this tale, Orpheus, the legendary musician, travels to the land of faeries to rescue his wife Eurydice from the underworld. Averie is one of the fairy queens who plays a role in Orpheus' journey and eventual reunion with his wife.
